entries.desc: abi version gate; the loader calls it at instantiate and refuses anything != 1

linear-memory offset for the host-written msgpack args; 0 = refusal; <=128B calls reuse one fixed slot (§3.1); larger bumps return heap_buf-based addresses (P3-T2: the bare-offset era handed out .rodata-range offsets and heap_buf was optimized away)

spi_config(slot0, SCL=41, 40MHz, MOSI=42, MISO=14 (legal unwired pin — the v1 engine rejects -1: pins_valid wants 0..47 on all three bus pins, the frozen doc's '-1=absent' is not implemented there; fix-round-1 moved 13->14: 13 is the camera PCLK, and the engine holds the claim for the module's whole loaded lifetime, so MISO=13 made st7789 and the camera mutually exclusive — 14 is free outside the camera epoch's 4-13,15-18), mode, no_cs=1) + hardware RES pulse + SLPOUT/COLMOD(16bit)/MADCTL(0x00)/INVON/CASET/RASET/DISPON. cfg keys optional: x_offset 0..80 clamped (default 0 — the glass start offset; lands on RASET at MADCTL=0x00 since a 240x240 glass bonds all 240 sources and 240 of 320 gates), mode 0..3 clamped (default 3 = CPOL1/CPHA2, the ST7789 4-line sample edge), invon bool (default true — common 240x240 IPS glass needs inversion for true colors; eyeball-tunable). ~250ms of delay_ms inside one call. A held spi slot surfaces as the host's rt exception (owner conflict). The reply also publishes xfer_lo (P3-T2): the overlap-free floor for external frames — xfer the frame host-side to [xfer_lo, xfer_lo+115200), then blit(xfer_lo).
fb fill (wire-order RGB565 hi byte first) + full-frame stream; color default 0 (black); 115,200B in 29 spi_xfer chunks (engine cap 4096B/xfer).

stream one full frame (115,200B wire-order RGB565) from linear memory at buf_off; 0/absent = the module fb (pure re-stream, the SPI timing path). Nonzero must satisfy xfer_lo <= buf_off and buf_off+115200 <= 262144, where xfer_lo is the self-derived statics ceiling published by init (P3-T2, T8 FINDING-B: the historical floor of 8 covered the module's own statics — a legal-looking full-frame xfer there wrote the frame over .rodata reply keys and state scalars; garbage reply maps until reload). The frame span sits above every static byte and covers the dead inter-call wasm stack (frames are rebuilt per call). Sub-floor/over-ceiling offsets answer {error='blit offset out of bounds'}. Same byte order as camera RGB565 frames (hi byte first) — a QVGA crop can be blitted verbatim.

entries.signature: [kind] -> {ok, kind, windows, bytes, chunks, fill_ms, xfer_ms, total_ms}
entries.desc: kind: 'full' solid white (fb path); 'border' four 8px white partial-window strips at the glass edge (offset probe: flush at edge = x_offset right, inset ~80 rows = wrong candidate; interior untouched); 'quad' 120x120 quadrants TL=red TR=green BL=blue BR=white (partial windows; orientation/RGB-order eyeball); 'red_rect' black frame + centered 100x100 red at (70,70) (fb path). Unknown/missing kind -> {error='unknown pattern kind' / 'pattern kind required'}. Partial-window kinds report fill_ms 0 (stage fills counted in xfer_ms).
DISPOFF + 20ms + SLPIN (panel to sleep). The spi slot and RES/DC pin claims REMAIN (abi=1 has no release host fn) — released by session_reset(loader) / vm.reopen like every wasm claim.

ops.name: init
ops.semantics: spi_config(slot0, SCL=41, 40MHz, MOSI=42, MISO=14 legal-unwired, mode, no_cs=1) + hardware RES pulse + SLPOUT/COLMOD(16bit)/MADCTL(0x00)/INVON/CASET/RASET/DISPON. cfg keys all optional: x_offset 0..80 clamped (default 0 — the glass start offset; lands on RASET at MADCTL=0x00 since a 240x240 glass bonds all 240 sources and 240 of 320 gates), mode 0..3 clamped (default 3 = CPOL1/CPHA2, the ST7789 4-line sample edge), invon bool (default true — common 240x240 IPS glass needs inversion for true colors; eyeball-tunable). ~250ms of delays inside one call. A held spi slot surfaces as the host's rt exception (owner conflict). The reply publishes xfer_lo (P3-T2): the overlap-free floor for external frames

ops.name: clear
ops.semantics: fb fill (wire-order RGB565 hi byte first) + full-frame stream; color default 0 (black); 115,200B in 29 spi_xfer chunks (engine cap 4096B/xfer)

ops.name: blit
ops.semantics: stream one full frame (115,200B wire-order RGB565) from linear memory at buf_off; 0/absent = the module fb (pure re-stream, the SPI timing path). Nonzero must satisfy xfer_lo <= buf_off and buf_off+115200 <= 262144, where xfer_lo is the self-derived statics ceiling published by init (P3-T2, T8 FINDING-B: the historical floor of 8 covered the module's own statics — a legal-looking full-frame xfer there wrote the frame over .rodata and the state scalars). The frame span may cover the wasm stack above the statics: inter-call stack bytes are dead by wasm semantics. Same byte order as camera RGB565 frames (hi byte first) — a QVGA crop can be blitted verbatim. Violations → {error='blit offset out of bounds'}

ops.name: pattern
ops.result: {ok, kind, windows, bytes, chunks, fill_ms, xfer_ms, total_ms}
ops.semantics: kind: 'full' solid white (fb path); 'border' four 8px white partial-window strips at the glass edge (offset probe: flush at edge = x_offset right, inset ~80 rows = wrong candidate); 'quad' 120x120 quadrants TL=red TR=green BL=blue BR=white (partial windows; orientation/RGB-order eyeball); 'red_rect' black frame + centered 100x100 red at (70,70) (fb path; camera-contrast eyeball). Unknown/missing kind → {error}. Partial-window kinds report fill_ms 0 (stage fills counted in xfer_ms)

ops.name: deinit
ops.semantics: DISPOFF + 20ms + SLPIN (panel to sleep). The spi slot and RES/DC pin claims REMAIN (abi=1 has no release host fn) — released by session_reset(loader) / vm.reopen, like every wasm claim

linear_memory.note: 4 wasm pages: fb 115200 + stage 4096 + out 2048 + heap 8192 (materialized P3-T2) + args 128 + cmd 8 + scalars ~= 130KB + wasm-ld 64KB stack -> statics+stack end at 196,480. External blit window [xfer_lo=130,960, 146,944] sits above every static (overlap-free by statics_end() arithmetic; tools/verify_st7789_blit.mjs pins it against the built wasm) and spans the dead inter-call stack. Same budget class as hello; co-loads with ledwatch in the 2MiB WAMR pool.
